summary: 合同变更后续只读片 on BASE 71d5665. Added contracts.approval_services.contract_change_impact(member, change_id) and contract_change_impact_list(member, *, contract_id=None): a read-only projection over the existing Contract/ContractVersion/ContractChange/Settlement/OpenItem/Clearance/RevenueRecognition facts, returning the change ref/type/status/requested date/version, contract ref/status/termination marker, the approved version before the change (the version with version_no-1 for an effective price/other change; the still-approved version for a termination) and the new approved version after it (None for termination), affected contract-line refs (before and after lines unioned), active Settlement count/gross, active OpenItem count/gross, active Clearance count/cleared amount, posted RevenueRecognition count/net amount, and the change deltas. The service is append-only read behaviour: no audit, receipt, event or fact write; permissions are owner/finance/auditor, PM only for managed projects with summary_only=true, member denied, cross-company/unknown change denied. Termination depth: the existing PH-265 guards (change draft requires an active contract; approved_terms_snapshot rejects as_of >= terminated_on) were kept without duplicating settlement write code, and the read snapshots now expose terminated/terminated_on/contract_status markers so downstream pairing is never silent; regressions assert new change and settlement attempts after termination are refused with zero half-writes. Browser: contract detail gained a read-only 变更影响（只读） section (before/after versions, affected lines, settlement/open-item/clearance/revenue counts and amounts, termination badge, link to per-change impact) and a new read-only change_detail.html page; a history_read route contract-change-impact keeps the historical impact readable after the contracts module is disabled, with no new write entry. No model/migration/canonical topic/command/schema change and no revenue/ledger/cash/open-item write.
